_comment: Mutation testing for the SECURITY-CRITICAL libs only (access control, download-token signing, citation extraction + verification, the SSRF private-IP guard). These are the modules where a test suite that merely *executes* lines without *asserting* behavior is dangerous, so we pay the mutation-testing cost here and nowhere else. Runs as a PR gate only when these files/tests change (mutation.yml path filter), on demand via `npm run test:mutation`, and monthly via cron. ignoreStatic: module-load-time mutants (e.g. the BlockList subnet tables in privateIp.ts) cannot be toggled by Stryker's mutation switching and would survive spuriously; runtime behavior of those tables is asserted by privateIp.test.ts instead. Floors only go up: when tests kill more mutants, raise thresholds.break in the same PR. Widen mutate only alongside tests that keep the score above the floor. Measured 2026-08-27 with all five files: 70.01.
